properties.chose: Option (b), on Anthony's word "keep the public-case trial for Joe" (2026-10-25): a trial on a case whose record is public (or a fictional one), played by agents as the Chris and HARRIER trials were. Option (a), a real matter, waits on integrated-flo dec:idea-a-person-keeps-confidential-material-in-a-design, still open. properties.decision: Try it first on a public (or fictional) case record, played by agents: req:a-trial-designs-a-public-legal-case-as-a-line-of-reasoning. A real matter waits on the confidentiality question.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-25 — a lawyer's case work (discovery organised and analysed, questions for witnesses) is tried as a line of reasoning FIRST on a public case record, played by agents, before any real matter
properties.rationale:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-10-25, relaying a family member who is a lawyer: they pay for and use ChatGPT "to help him organize and analyze discovery, suggest questions for witnesses, etc.", and it is "somewhat limited what he can use it for due to confidentiality". Anthony: "I figured our work in lines of reasoning would help him do this."

A legal case is already in scope: req:a-design-holds-a-line-of-reasoning (accepted) names it, and the design-an-argument skill is served. What is open is whether this use fits, and how to try it. Ideas, none chosen:

(a) The case as a line of reasoning: each thing to be proved is a claim; it rests on exhibits (cited by number) and testimony; the other side's positions are objections that contest it. reasoning_report then reads back what is unsupported, what is contested, and what each conclusion rests on. Those weak points are where the questions for a witness come from.

(b) A trial first on a case whose record is public (a decided case with public filings and transcripts) or a fictional one, played by agents the way the Chris argument trial and the HARRIER fictional-intelligence trial were, before any real matter. Cheap: one trial agent and public sources.

(c) Structure, not substance: the design holds only the shape of the argument, with neutral labels and exhibit numbers, while the documents stay in the firm's own systems.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, recorded beside: (1) Confidentiality is the very limit the lawyer already meets, and flo2 does not lift it: a design on flo2.io adds parties (flo2's operator and its backups) to the chat vendor; see integrated-flo dec:idea-a-person-keeps-confidential-material-in-a-design. (a) on a real matter is blocked until that question is answered. (2) As with Chris, the design is the lawyer's to build; we give no legal advice. (3) Their chat app is ChatGPT, whose door is itself open: flo2 dec:idea-a-chatgpt-user-designs-through-flo2.
